conclusion.summary: The unchanged baseline produced two exact first-policy modes. Repetitions 1 and 2 were byte-identical valid development runs; every repetition-3 attempt produced a second byte-identical raw mode whose first input differed across self observation, mimic targets, and terrain and changed the first action. The two hashes exactly reproduce the two pre-intervention modes that confounded E4. The repetition and run ID fields are metadata-only, so no intentional runtime branch explains the split. Repetition-3 full-run outcomes remain INVALID because CaptureRender failed before manifest publication.
conclusion.what_was_learned: E4's pre-intervention mismatch was not an isolated malformed snapshot and was not caused by the remap-bypass branch. The fixture can enter at least two reproducible startup modes before semantic action intervention. Because the alternate raw mode also changes later actions and physics materially, semantic A/B experiments must first identify and lock the shared upstream observation source.

next_highest_information_experiment.name: First-policy observation provenance trace
next_highest_information_experiment.hypothesis: The two first-policy modes originate in a shared initial root/pose observation source before tensor flattening, rather than in NNE inference or action decoding.
next_highest_information_experiment.instrumentation: Behind a development-only trace flag, capture the first policy step's actor and skeletal-component transforms, live root transform, per-body transforms used by self observation, PoseSearch selection/time and target root, previous-action state, and terrain sample origin/raw height before normalization and tensor packing.
next_highest_information_experiment.method: First prove trace-on versus trace-off raw streams are bit-identical. Then run unchanged launches with the same binary until both known first-snapshot hashes appear and compare the earliest provenance field that differs.
next_highest_information_experiment.expected_if_correct: One shared pre-flattening root, pose, or terrain-origin value separates the two known snapshot hashes before NNE execution.
next_highest_information_experiment.falsifier: All captured pre-flattening sources are identical while the packed first-policy tensors differ; investigation then moves to tensor assembly or memory ownership.
next_highest_information_experiment.locked_metrics: Exact physics/policy/snapshot hashes for trace neutrality, exact known first-snapshot hashes, per-source transform deltas, PoseSearch identity/time, previous-action equality, and existing locked standing-plant metrics without threshold changes.
